name: Truck Driver: The Dutch Connection
storyline:
Discover a brand-new narrative with new memorable characters, navigating family, friendships, and personal challenges while delivering precious loads.
Cruise through a vibrant open world inspired by Dutch landscapes, with iconic windmills turning in the breeze.
Embrace the European trucking life at your own pace with a relaxing Freedom-to Roam mode.
Built with the latest technologies provided by Unreal Engine 5 and supporting ray tracing.
summary: Set in a reimagined Netherlands in 2027, discover a new era of trucking where AI dispatchers work alongside human drivers and the industry is thriving. Join Lucas and Felix as they face new challenges, forge alliances, and adapt to an evolving industry in this next chapter of the Truck Driver series.
